columns.comment: Calendar date of the cash flow. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the cash flow as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the cash flow, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the cash flow).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Payment purpose of the flow: Supplier, Payroll, Tax, Intercompany, Loan Service, Dividend, Trade Settlement; Closing Balance / Month Total on the balance and monthly-summary rows.
columns.name: Cashflow Category

columns.comment: Operating (supplier, payroll, tax, trade settlement), Financing (loan service, dividend), Intercompany, Balance or Month Total.
columns.name: Cashflow Category Group

columns.comment: Client's coverage office / booking location (ISO-2).
columns.name: Booking Country

columns.comment: Calendar month number 1-12 of the date (3 = March fiscal year-end, 9 = September half-year) - group by it for seasonality.
columns.name: Calendar Month

columns.comment: The client's final early-warning band today (30-Sep-2026): Green, Amber or Red; null = not scored. Use it for "Red / Amber clients" (EWS Band is the band at each row's month-end).
columns.name: Current EWS Band

columns.comment: Inbound payments received in USD over the selection (a flow; Flow rows).
columns.name: Inflow USD

columns.comment: Outbound payments made in USD over the selection (a flow; Flow rows).
columns.name: Outflow USD

columns.comment: Inflows - outflows over the selection, USD (negative = net outflow).
columns.name: Net Cashflow USD

columns.comment: Client's total end-of-day deposit balance (CASA + TD) in USD at the last date of the selection (point-in-time; Balance rows - daily from Dec-2025, month-ends before; never summed across dates).
columns.name: Closing Balance USD

columns.comment: CASA (operating cash) part of the closing balance, USD (point-in-time, last date of the selection).
columns.name: Closing CASA Balance USD

columns.comment: Average of the clients' monthly inflows over the selected months (Month Total rows; per client when grouped by Client).
columns.name: Average Monthly Inflow USD

columns.comment: Standard deviation of monthly inflows over the selected months (Month Total rows) - group by Client and filter 12 months for a client's inflow volatility.
columns.name: Inflow Volatility USD

columns.comment: Standard deviation / average of monthly inflows (fraction; 0.6 = 60%) - volatility comparable across client sizes.
columns.name: Inflow Volatility CV %

columns.comment: Actual inflows / the clients' flat average monthly inflow for the selected months (1.0 = average; 1.3 = 30% above a typical month). Group by Industry and Calendar Month to find March / September peaks.
columns.name: Seasonality Index

columns.comment: Legal entities with at least one payment in the selection.
columns.name: Clients with Cash Flows

comment: Client operating cash flows derived from payments, daily from Apr-2024 to Sep-2026 (USD): inflows, outflows and net cash flow by cash-flow category (payment purpose), the closing deposit balance, average monthly inflow, inflow volatility (standard deviation and coefficient of variation of monthly inflows) and the seasonality index (actual / flat-average inflow; above 1 = seasonal peak, e.g. March fiscal year-end or September half-year). Inflows and outflows add up over any period; Closing Balance is POINT-IN-TIME (last date of the selection; daily from Dec-2025, month-ends before). For seasonality group by Calendar Month; for volatility group by Client over 12 months. Grain: one row per client x date x cash-flow category (payment purpose, Closing Balance or Month Total) (gold.fact_client_cashflow_daily).
